record.evidence_quote: It is known that Li-ion conductivity of solid-ion-conductor Li2 Al2 SiP2 TiO13 (HFKejing) is 10−4 S cm−1 as T>160 K.
record.notes: Value is stated as generally known for the commercial solid-ion conductor used as the gate, with no citation and no measurement in this paper, so it is marked literature_cited. The temperature is a lower bound (T>160 K), not a measurement temperature, so the numeric field is null. Material is a gate electrolyte, not the study's主 material; the paper does not name its structure class.
